comment: lab4dual DUAL SMART-PLUG TRAINING scenarios (10 of 16) held-in set for QL training. Held-OUT (test-only): 3 (the signature DOUBLE trap: both switches on, both plugs off), 4, 8, 12, 14, 15 (spotlight-redundancy and energy-optimization cases). Plugs start OFF wherever a lamp is needed, so the agent learns BOTH power dependencies (z1lamp_on = Z1Light AND PlugZ1; z2lamp_on = Z2Light AND PlugZ2). Scenarios 7 and 11 are the held-in ASYMMETRIC single-plug traps (one zone lit, the other switch-on-plug-off). Full sun coverage (ranks 0..3). Targets Z1=bright(3), Z2=bright(3).
description: sun=0, all off, both plugs off -> enable both plugs + both lamps
sun=0, both at target via lamps (plugs on) -> hold
sun=1, all off, plugs off -> enable both plugs + both lamps
sun=1, both at target via lamps (plugs on) -> hold
sun=1, Z1 lit, Z2 switch ON but PlugZ2 OFF -> turn PlugZ2 on (held-in asymmetric trap)
sun=2, all off, plugs off -> enable both plugs + both lamps
sun=2, both at target via lamps (plugs on) -> hold
sun=2, Z2 lit, Z1 switch ON but PlugZ1 OFF -> turn PlugZ1 on (held-in asymmetric trap)
sun=3, all off -> open both blinds (835 each, zero energy)
sun=3, both at target via blinds only -> hold
